script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: MENDING HEARTS

FADE IN:

INT. RUSTIC KITCHEN - DAY

Anna, mid-30s, a talented chef, stands in her kitchen, preparing a meal for a dinner party. Her eyes fill with tears as she recalls an argument she had with her husband, LUCAS, last night.

ANNA
(speaking to herself)
I can't believe we're here again.

The timer goes off, snapping her back to the present. She checks the lasagna in the oven and takes a deep breath before proceeding with the rest of her menu.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

The dinner party is in full swing, with guests mingling and enjoying Anna's culinary creations. Amidst the laughter and conversation, Lucas enters the room.

ANNA
(smiling weakly)
Lucas, it's nice to see you.

LUCAS
(nervously)
Anna, I've come to apologize.

ANNA
(raising an eyebrow)
Really? I wasn't aware there was anything to apologize for.

Lucas hesitates, then speaks from the heart.

LUCAS
I've been an idiot. I've let my work consume me, and in doing so, I've neglected you and our family. I'm sorry.

ANNA
(surprised)
You really mean that?

LUCAS
Yes, I do. I want to make things right. I want to spend more time with you and our children. I want to rebuild our relationship.

Anna looks at him, her expression softening.

ANNA
Then let's start over.

INT. COZY LIVING ROOM - DAY

Anna and Lucas sit on the couch together, their hands intertwined. The sun streams in through the windows, casting a warm glow over the room.

ANNA
(voice trembling)
I forgive you, Lucas. But I can't forget the pain you've caused me. It will take time to heal, but I'm willing to give our relationship another chance.

LUCAS
(tearfully)
I promise to make it worth your while. I'll be there for you, and for our family. I'll make it up to you.

They share a heartfelt moment, their eyes locked as they exchange promises of love and forgiveness.

INT. ANNA'S STUDIO - NIGHT

Anna works on a new recipe in her studio, humming to herself as she experiments with different ingredients. Lucas enters the room, carrying a bouquet of flowers.

LUCAS
(smiling)
I thought you might like these.

ANNA
(grinning)
They're beautiful. Thank you.

They share a tender moment, their bond stronger than ever.

INT. BACKYARD - SUNSET

Anna and Lucas sit on a blanket in the backyard, watching the sunset together. They talk about their dreams, their fears, and their hopes for the future.

ANNA
I'm glad we've found our way back to each other, Lucas.

LUCAS
Me too, Anna. Me too.

They share a loving kiss as the sun sets behind them, marking the beginning of a new chapter in their lives.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
